parameters.jsCode:
const formData = $('01 Form Submission Webhook').first().json || {};
const runId = Date.now().toString(36);

// Build opportunity analysis data
const opps = [
  {
    id: `${runId}-O1`,
    theme: 'Corporate gifting for executives',
    buyer_intent: 'Corporate gifting, bulk orders, VIP presents',
    tier: 'Tier 1',
    audience: 'HR heads, PAs, procurement officers, C-suite assistants',
    market: formData['market'] || 'KSA',
    language: formData['language'] || 'English',
    search_query: 'corporate gifts ' + (formData['market'] || 'KSA'),
    seasonal: 'Ramadan, Eid, Saudi National Day, year-end gifting',
    cultural: 'Majlis hospitality, Arabic gifting traditions',
    competitor: 'Other B2B fragrance/gift suppliers in KSA',
    gap: 'Limited digital presence for corporate gifting options'
  },
  {
    id: `${runId}-O2`,
    theme: 'Hotel and hospitality scent solutions',
    buyer_intent: 'Hotel scenting, majlis fragrance, boutique hotel amenities',
    tier: 'Tier 2',
    audience: 'Hotel GMs, F&B managers, majlis owners, interior buyers',
    market: formData['market'] || 'KSA',
    language: formData['language'] || 'English',
    search_query: 'hotel scenting ' + (formData['market'] || 'KSA'),
    seasonal: 'Seasonal hospitality events, conferences',
    cultural: 'Arabic hospitality traditions, Majlis scenting',
    competitor: 'Other hospitality scent providers',
    gap: 'Seasonal menu and event scent offerings'
  },
  {
    id: `${runId}-O3`,
    theme: 'Healthcare and spa fragrance solutions',
    buyer_intent: 'Clinic scenting, spa ambience, premium medical environment',
    tier: 'Tier 3',
    audience: 'Clinic owners, spa managers, procurement',
    market: formData['market'] || 'KSA',
    language: formData['language'] || 'English',
    search_query: 'clinic fragrance ' + (formData['market'] || 'KSA'),
    seasonal: 'Health awareness months, wellness trends',
    cultural: 'Premium healthcare environment expectations',
    competitor: 'Medical and spa scenting companies',
    gap: 'Wellness-focused fragrance positioning'
  },
  {
    id: `${runId}-O4`,
    theme: 'Corporate wellness and interior architecture scenting',
    buyer_intent: 'Office wellness, scent branding, fit-out specifications',
    tier: 'Tier 4',
    audience: 'Facility managers, interior architects, HR wellbeing leads',
    market: formData['market'] || 'KSA',
    language: formData['language'] || 'English',
    search_query: 'office wellness scent ' + (formData['market'] || 'KSA'),
    seasonal: 'Corporate wellness programs, year-end',
    cultural: 'Workplace culture and scent preferences',
    competitor: 'Corporate wellness and scent branding firms',
    gap: 'B2B scent branding for interior projects'
  }
];

// Return an array of objects so each opportunity is written as its own row
return [{ json: opps[0] }], [{ json: opps[1] }], [{ json: opps[2] }], [{ json: opps[3] }];

parameters.responseBody: = { success: true, runId, opportunitiesCount: $('Build Opportunities').first().json.opportunities.length, message: 'Opportunity analysis complete. Saved to opportunities tab.' }
